mapper.select: SELECT id,row_version,created_at,updated_at,owner_id,workspace_id,canonical_name,aliases::text AS aliases_json,status FROM characters WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id,row_version,created_at,updated_at,owner_id,workspace_id,canonical_name,aliases::text AS aliases_json,status FROM characters WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND (updated_at < #{updatedAt} OR (updated_at=#{updatedAt} AND id < #{id})) ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM characters WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND status=#{status}

SELECT id,row_version,created_at,updated_at,owner_id,workspace_id,canonical_name,aliases::text AS aliases_json,status FROM characters WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND status <> #{excludedStatus}

SELECT id,row_version,created_at,updated_at,owner_id,workspace_id,canonical_name,aliases::text AS aliases_json,status FROM characters WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND status <> #{excludedStatus} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,row_version,created_at,updated_at,owner_id,workspace_id,canonical_name,aliases::text AS aliases_json,status FROM characters WHERE id=#{id}

INSERT INTO characters (row_version,created_at,updated_at,owner_id,workspace_id,canonical_name,aliases,status) VALUES (#{rowVersion},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt},#{ownerId},#{workspaceId},#{canonicalName},CAST(#{aliasesJson} AS jsonb),#{status}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE characters SET owner_id=#{ownerId},workspace_id=#{workspaceId},canonical_name=#{canonicalName},aliases=CAST(#{aliasesJson} AS jsonb),status=#{status},updated_at=#{updatedAt},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_number),0) FROM character_versions WHERE character_id=#{characterId}

SELECT cv.id,cv.row_version,cv.created_at,cv.updated_at,cv.character_id,cv.version_number,cv.bible,cv.visual_prompt,cv.status,cv.locked_at,cv.locked_by FROM character_versions cv JOIN characters c ON c.id=cv.character_id WHERE cv.id=#{id} AND c.owner_id=#{ownerId}

INSERT INTO character_versions (row_version,created_at,updated_at,character_id,version_number,bible,visual_prompt,status,locked_at,locked_by) VALUES (#{rowVersion},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt},#{characterId},#{versionNumber},#{bible},#{visualPrompt},#{status},#{lockedAt},#{lockedBy}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE character_versions SET character_id=#{characterId},version_number=#{versionNumber},bible=#{bible},visual_prompt=#{visualPrompt},status=#{status},locked_at=#{lockedAt},locked_by=#{lockedBy},updated_at=#{updatedAt},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_number),0) FROM outfit_versions WHERE character_id=#{characterId}

SELECT ov.id,ov.row_version,ov.created_at,ov.updated_at,ov.character_id,ov.version_number,ov.name,ov.description,ov.prompt,ov.status FROM outfit_versions ov JOIN characters c ON c.id=ov.character_id WHERE ov.id=#{id} AND c.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND c.status <> #{excludedStatus}

INSERT INTO outfit_versions (row_version,created_at,updated_at,character_id,version_number,name,description,prompt,status) VALUES (#{rowVersion},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt},#{characterId},#{versionNumber},#{name},#{description},#{prompt},#{status}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE outfit_versions SET character_id=#{characterId},version_number=#{versionNumber},name=#{name},description=#{description},prompt=#{prompt},status=#{status},updated_at=#{updatedAt},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}

mapper.update: UPDATE character_appearances SET character_id=#{characterId},project_id=#{projectId},timeline_key=#{timelineKey},age_state=#{ageState},hairstyle=#{hairstyle},injury=#{injury},wardrobe_context=#{wardrobeContext},appearance_prompt=#{appearancePrompt},outfit_version_id=#{outfitVersionId},updated_at=#{updatedAt},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}

INSERT INTO project_characters (row_version,created_at,updated_at,project_id,character_id,role,importance,project_aliases,story_metadata,groups_json,pinned_character_version_id,status) VALUES (#{rowVersion},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt},#{projectId},#{characterId},#{role},#{importance},CAST(#{projectAliasesJson} AS jsonb),#{storyMetadata},CAST(#{groupsJson} AS jsonb),#{pinnedCharacterVersionId},#{status}) RETURNING id
